tasks.subject: Task 1: Vendor reading fonts into InkWorld
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Embed Newsreader, Fraunces, Hanken Grotesk into InkWorld's FontBook so `#set text(font: ...)` resolves deterministically.

**Files:** crates/inkapp-core/assets/fonts/*.ttf (7 vendored), crates/inkapp-core/src/world.rs

**Verify:** nix develop -c cargo test --workspace

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/inkapp-core/assets/fonts", "crates/inkapp-core/src/world.rs"], "verifyCommand": "nix develop -c cargo test --workspace", "acceptanceCriteria": ["7 TTFs vendored", "FontBook contains Newsreader family", "workspace tests pass"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Theme type, reader() default, and Typst prelude
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add Theme struct with reader() default, chained builder, and prelude() emitting the Typst styling block. Register module + re-export from inkapp-core.

**Files:** crates/inkapp-core/src/theme.rs (new), crates/inkapp-core/src/lib.rs

**Verify:** nix develop -c cargo test -p inkapp-core theme::

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/inkapp-core/src/theme.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/src/lib.rs"], "verifyCommand": "nix develop -c cargo test -p inkapp-core theme::", "acceptanceCriteria": ["reader() defaults correct", "default==reader", "prelude emits grayscale luma + fonts, never rgb", "builder overrides", "Theme re-exported"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Thread Theme through render API and App builder
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Inject theme prelude in document_source_in (replacing hardcoded #set text); add theme: &Theme sibling param across the _in* family; wrappers default to reader(); App gains theme field + .theme() builder; facade re-exports Theme.

**Files:** crates/inkapp-core/src/runtime.rs, crates/inkapp/src/lib.rs

**Verify:** nix develop -c cargo test --workspace

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/inkapp-core/src/runtime.rs", "crates/inkapp/src/lib.rs"], "verifyCommand": "nix develop -c cargo test --workspace", "acceptanceCriteria": ["prelude replaces #set text line", "theme sibling param on _in* family", "wrappers default reader()", "App.theme() builder", "nonempty PDF + byte-identical determinism", "facade re-export"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Harness golden for reader-themed output
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Golden test rendering reader theme over heading + justified body + block quote + raw span via inspect(); commit reviewed PNG.

**Files:** crates/inkapp-harness/tests/theme.rs (new), crates/inkapp-harness/tests/golden/theme_reader.png (generated)

**Verify:** nix develop -c cargo test -p inkapp-harness theme_reader

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/inkapp-harness/tests/theme.rs", "crates/inkapp-harness/tests/golden/theme_reader.png"], "verifyCommand": "nix develop -c cargo test -p inkapp-harness theme_reader", "acceptanceCriteria": ["styled snippet compiles + rasterizes + matches golden", "golden committed after review"]}
```
